title: EUDR geolocation evidence: supplier readiness check
description: A free EUDR supplier-evidence pre-check for geolocation, batch linkage and Information System readiness before the applicable date.
intro: Coordinates alone are not a complete evidence chain. Check whether each batch can be linked to a current product-scope decision, its production origin, quantity and supporting due-diligence work before a statement is prepared.
boundary: This tool records your own readiness answers. It does not determine whether a product is in Annex I, whether your organisation is an operator or trader, whether an exception applies, or whether a due diligence statement is valid.
sizeLabel: Which description are you using for planning?
sizes: Micro or small operator already covered by EUTR
deadlineUnknown: Confirm the product code, applicable amendment and organisation category before relying on a date.
deadline2026: Planning date shown by the Commission: 30 December 2026.
deadline2027: Planning date shown by the Commission: 30 June 2027.
scopeNote: The Regulation covers specified products made from the listed commodities. Confirm the exact product code against the current Annex I and amendments; do not infer scope from the family name alone. Products newly added by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/2102 have a separate application date of 30 December 2027.
privacy: No login or upload. Answers stay in this browser page and can be downloaded as a local text checklist.
items: Has the exact product code been checked against the current EUDR scope?
Record the code, legal source version and the person who made the scope decision.
Is the country of production known for every batch or shipment being reviewed?
Ask the supplier to map each batch to its country of production.
Are production plots represented by usable coordinates or areas?
Request coordinates in an agreed format; the Information System supports map entry and bulk GeoJSON.
Can the coordinates be linked to the product description, HS code and quantity?
Create a batch-level cross-reference so location data is not an unlabelled file.
Are legality and deforestation-free supporting records assigned to the same batch?
List the evidence owner, document date and batch reference; do not upload confidential files here.
Has the responsible operator confirmed access to the correct production environment?
Production submissions have legal value; acceptance-server submissions are for testing only.
empty: Choose a status for each item, then generate the checklist.
done: All six items are marked available by you. This is not proof of compliance or a valid due diligence statement.
limit: The result does not validate coordinates, documents, product scope, risk assessment, mitigation or an official submission.
explain: The Commission says the Information System lets operators create due diligence statements, indicate exact origins by map or coordinates, and provide product details such as HS code, description and quantity. Production submissions have legal value; acceptance-server submissions do not.
next: Choose one product code and one shipment instead of asking for every supplier file at once.
Request a batch-to-plot map plus the named evidence owner.
Test formatting in the acceptance environment, then complete the authorised production workflow separately.
faqs: The Commission lists cattle, wood, cocoa, soy, palm oil, coffee and rubber, plus specified derived products. Exact product scope depends on the current legal annex and amendments.

The Commission lists 30 December 2026 for large and medium operators and micro or small operators already covered by EUTR, and 30 June 2027 for other micro and small operators. Confirm how your organisation is classified. Products newly added by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/2102 apply from 30 December 2027; check the exact code and amendment.
Can I use the acceptance server for a legal submission?
No. The Commission states that acceptance-server submissions have no legal value. Production-server submissions can have legal value and may be checked by competent authorities.
Does EcoBack verify my coordinates or documents?
No. This page only creates a local checklist from your answers; it does not access the EU system or verify evidence.
offerTitle: Free first; paid pilot is not open
offer: Use this checker before buying help. A proposed €299 evidence-readiness pilot would cover one product family, a bilingual evidence index and supplier request templates. Checkout, tax treatment, scope and delivery terms are not connected or agreed yet.
disclaimer: Independent preparation aid. Not an EU service, legal advice, product-scope decision, certification, verification or due diligence statement.
